name: camayoc_gp_backtest_outcomes
description: golden-paths Q13: did work items that conformed to this path close done more than the ones that deviated? Returns each follower's outcome and deviation so the rates are computed by the reader - the store holds facts, not the decaying judgment.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?trajectory ?workitem ?outcome ?deviation WHERE { ?trajectory a aegis:Trajectory ; aegis:followsPath <{path}> ; aegis:trajectoryOf ?workitem . OPTIONAL { ?workitem aegis:outcome ?outcome } OPTIONAL { ?trajectory aegis:deviatesAt ?deviation } } ORDER BY ?workitem
